introduction_markdown:
**General Certificate of Education Board - General Certificate of Education Examination. Pure Mathematics With Statistics, Paper 3 (0770/3), ADVANCED LEVEL, June 2022. Time allowed: THREE HOURS.**

Full marks may be obtained for answers to ALL questions. Mathematical formulae and tables produced by the GCE Board are allowed. In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving the answer at each stage. Electronic calculators may be used. Start each question on a fresh page.

Question 8 (b) : « the least squares regression line of Economics on Geography marks » est lu comme la droite de $x$ (Economics) en fonction de $y$ (Geography) : $x = a + by$ ; c'est la droite utilisée en (c) pour estimer $x$ à partir de $y = 55$. questions.enonce_markdown: (a) Calculate, to 3 decimal places, the Pearson product-moment correlation coefficient for this distribution.
(b) Find the least squares regression line of Economics on Geography marks.
questions.corrige_markdown:
Economics ($x$) is regressed on Geography ($y$), so the line is $x = a + by$ with $b = \dfrac{S_{xy}}{S_{yy}}$ and $a = \bar{x} - b\bar{y}$ (equivalently $x - \bar{x} = b(y - \bar{y})$).

$$b = \frac{S_{xy}}{S_{yy}} = \frac{2629.4}{1638.9} = 1.6044\ldots$$

$$a = \bar{x} - b\bar{y} = 62.4 - 1.6044 \times 44.9 = 62.4 - 72.036 = -9.636\ldots$$

**$x = -9.64 + 1.604\,y$**, that is $x - 62.4 = 1.6044\,(y - 44.9)$ (the line passes through $(\bar{y}, \bar{x}) = (44.9, 62.4)$).

questions.enonce_markdown: (c) Estimate the marks in Economics of a candidate who scored 55 marks in Geography.
questions.corrige_markdown:
Put $y = 55$ in the regression line of Economics on Geography:

$$x = -9.636 + 1.6044 \times 55 = -9.636 + 88.242 = 78.6$$

(Check: $x = 62.4 + 1.6044\,(55 - 44.9) = 62.4 + 16.204 = 78.6$.)

**The estimated Economics mark is about 78.6, that is 79 marks.** This is an interpolation ($y = 55$ lies inside the range 27 to 68 of the data) and $r = 0.963$ is close to 1, so the estimate is reliable.
